title: Acoustic Saturdays at Peppers Moonah Links
summary: Saturday evening acoustic sessions with local artists at Peppers Moonah Links. Happy hour 5–6pm. Free entry.
suitableFor: Adults, couples, groups, golf guests and locals
accessibilityNotes: Resort accessible; contact venue for specific requirements
nearbyAttractions: Arthurs Seat Eagle; Cape Schanck; Flinders
suggestedItineraryPairing: Round of golf during the day, settle in for happy hour and acoustic set from 5pm
editorVerdict: The Peninsula's best-value Saturday evening. Free entry, happy hour drinks, and live acoustic sets at a resort with proper views.
editorNote:
Every Saturday at Peppers Moonah Links, local acoustic artists play the resort lounge from 5pm. Entry is free. Happy hour runs 5–6pm with drinks at the bar - good value for a resort setting.

Good for anyone staying in the area or finishing a day of wine tasting and wanting to wind down without paying a ticket price. The resort setting feels like more than it costs.

Pair with Arthurs Seat Eagle during the day or a Cape Schanck walk, then come back for the 5pm set.
